game: NE @ CHI Week 7 2026 (morning of kickoff, pre-inactives)

script.base: CHI -3 in a 51 total implies CHI 27 / NE 24, a one-score game with both quarterbacks throwing. CHI leads late by a field goal, so D'Andre Swift and Roschon Johnson get the late carries with Kyle Monangai out, but the passing game (Colston Loveland, Rome Odunze, Luther Burden) stays live. NE, with C Ben Brown and G Alijah Vera-Tucker out, leans quick throws to Hunter Henry and DeMario Douglas while Rhamondre Stevenson still gets a full share because it never becomes a blowout.
script.flip1: CHI scores early and leads by 14+. Clock-killing carries funnel to Swift and Johnson, Caleb Williams's dropbacks stall, and Burden/Odunze/Loveland yardage unders hit while NE abandons the run so Stevenson rush dies and Drake Maye/Henry volume spikes.
script.flip2: NE's depleted secondary and both teams' middle leaks turn it into a shootout and correlated pass overs all cash together, or un-saved outdoor weather drags the 51 into a slog and every yardage over fails.

injury_fallout: Source: official pre-game injury report in the pack (nflverse). Edwards Doubtful remove the linebackers who would sit on NE TEs and RBs, so Henry, Eli Raridon, Stevenson and TreVeyon Henderson receiving gain; CB Tyrique Stevenson is only Questionable. NE OL is the rush killer: Vera-Tucker Out, Brown Out, Morgan Moses Questionable, so NE rushing efficiency should fall and quick throws (Henry, RB checks) should rise while deep air-yard WRs (Douglas 180 air, Romeo Doubs 221 air on the CHI side of the ball is separate) face more pressure. NE secondary is the CHI pass boost: CB Carlton Davis III, Karon Prunty and Channing Canada Out; CB Christian Gonzalez, S Kevin Byard and S Craig Woodson Questionable. That helps Burden, Odunze and Loveland. NE LB Christian Elliss Questionable is a smaller leak for CHI RB/TE targets. Final inactives (~90 min pre-kick) are not in the pack.

matchup.shell: MOFO/MOFC and man/zone charting are not in the pack. Proxy is location YPA: both defenses bleed the middle and are tighter outside, which fits a closed-middle / zone-hook problem more than an outside-corner problem, but that is an inference not a chart.
matchup.pressure: CHI blitzes 41%. NE EPA/db is 0.11 vs blitz and 0.21 vs none, so pressure hurts Maye and should cut deep WR yards while boosting TE/RB checks. NE blitzes 35%. CHI EPA/db is 0.16 vs blitz and 0.05 vs none, so NE pressure helps Caleb Williams rather than killing Burden/Odunze/Loveland.

matchup.overlap: CHI's top target is Loveland (21 tgt/141 yds/131 air, ~6.2 aDOT) into NE's middle hole, with the secondary outs as the personnel overlay. Burden (20/205/183, ~9.2 aDOT, 10.3 YPT) is the efficiency/explosive overlap against backup corners, not the middle hook. NE's clean overlap is Henry (14 tgt/154 yds/66 air, ~4.7 aDOT) into CHI's 12.18 middle YPA plus Sanborn/Edwards, with the 41% blitz and the NE OL outs forcing the quick game he already runs.

pre_mortem: It's Monday and both lost. Gonzalez, Byard and Woodson all played, NE sat two-high on Burden, and CHI led by two scores so Williams's attempts died after a 47-yard Burden game; the last4 median is only 62, so one missing explosive loses 57.5, and the -114 never beat a 0.502 fair price. Henry lost because Maye kept the ball on the blitz (13 carries, 110 yards in three games) instead of checking down, Douglas (180 air) and Doubs (221 air) took the intermediate shots, Edwards played through the hamstring, and the week-3 five-yard game was the real floor. Worse, Henry never had a two-sided price, so the 35 may not have been a real market. That price hole is the strongest process counter; the football counter is not stronger than three straight games of 44-plus against a 35, so the leg stays flagged for the human rather than cut.
slip_story: One story: competitive 51-point game, both teams throw. Burden over is the CHI pass-into-a-depleted-secondary leg; Henry over is the NE quick-game leg against the blitz and the middle. They win together in the base script and in the shootout flip. Do not add a total under, a CHI blowout Swift-carry stack, or a Stevenson rush over (those need the other script, and NE's center and guard are out). Two legs, no TDs, one market per player.
